teams.heroSub: A different kind of team-building experience.
teams.lede: Bring your colleagues together for an engaging evening of chess, conversation, and friendly competition. Discover new ways to think, connect beyond the workplace, and enjoy something different together.
teams.heroNote: No chess experience needed. Just curiosity and a willingness to play.
teams.learnBody: Start with the essentials through fun, accessible activities. Whether someone is a complete beginner or already knows the game, everyone can take part.
teams.thinkBody: Explore intriguing chess challenges together. Share ideas, compare approaches, and discover how differently people can see the same situation.
teams.playBody: Put everything into practice with guided games, friendly competition, and plenty of opportunities to laugh, talk, and connect.
teams.why1Body: Bring colleagues from different roles around the same board. Job titles matter less, conversations come naturally, and friendly competition helps people connect in unexpected ways.
teams.why2Body: Chess encourages curiosity, creative thinking, and looking at challenges from different perspectives. Every position offers an opportunity to explore options, make decisions, and adapt.
teams.why3Body: Everyone starts somewhere. Chess makes learning tangible: experiment, make mistakes, try new ideas, and enjoy the satisfaction of discovering something new.
teams.why4Body: Step away from screens, meetings, and everyday routines. Share an engaging activity that combines mental stimulation, social interaction, and the simple pleasure of playing together.
teams.atmoTitle: An evening people can enjoy together.
teams.atmoBody1: A relaxed setting, engaging challenges, friendly competition, and time to connect over drinks and snacks.
teams.atmoBody2: MadridMinds combines the intellectual appeal of chess with the pleasure of a great evening together. No presentations, no pressure, and no previous experience required.
teams.organizeTitle: You bring the team. We take care of the chess.
teams.organizeBody1: Whether you're welcoming new colleagues, organizing a team social, or planning something special for your company, we'll help create an experience that fits your group.
teams.organizeBody2: We guide the activities, provide the chess equipment, and make sure everyone feels welcome.
teams.organizeClosing: All you need to bring is your team.
teams.practicalGroup: Flexible. Tell us how many people you have in mind.
teams.practicalWhere: At your venue or a private space in Madrid, subject to availability.
teams.practicalFormat: Guided activities, collaborative challenges, and friendly games.
teams.practicalPricing: Tailored proposal based on your group and requirements.
teams.credBody1: MadridMinds draws on more than 20 years of experience in the international chess world to make the game accessible, engaging, and enjoyable.
teams.credBody2: Our philosophy is simple: chess is more than a game to master. It's a wonderful way to bring people together.
teams.finalTitle: Let's plan something different for your team.
teams.finalLede: Tell us your approximate group size, preferred dates, and what you have in mind. We'll suggest a format that fits and prepare a tailored proposal.

meta.title: About MadridMinds — Chess Experiences for Curious Adults in Madrid
meta.description: MadridMinds brings together chess, conversation and a relaxed setting for curious adults in Madrid. Experiences hosted in English.
meta.ogDescription: More than learning chess. Chess evenings for curious adults in Madrid.

about.lede: MadridMinds brings together chess, conversation, drinks and snacks, and a relaxed setting for adults who want to learn something new and spend an evening at the board.
about.p1: Chess is one of the world’s great games: strategic, social and endlessly interesting. MadridMinds makes it accessible through evenings where people can learn, play and enjoy the company around them.
about.p2: Every game asks you to focus, recognise patterns, weigh options, plan ahead and make decisions — with other people at the table. The challenge is real; the evening is meant to be enjoyed.
about.p3: Evenings are in English — a natural fit for Madrid’s international crowd.
about.hostBody1: I created MadridMinds because some things are just better shared.
about.hostBody2: I’ve spent over 20 years as a chess insider — helping make the game more accessible and fun for people around the world.
about.atmosphereBody: A comfortable setting, drinks and snacks, good conversation and time to actually engage with the people around you. Come to learn, or simply come because you want to try something different.
